name: Aquaguard Enrich Crest UV
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Crest is a premium inline UV water purifier for municipal water (TDS up to 200 mg/L).
intro: The Aquaguard Enrich Crest is a premium inline UV water purifier designed for municipal water (TDS up to 200 mg/L). Featuring Patented Active Copper Technology, UV E-Boiling, Mineral Guard Technology, and an intuitive LED display, it delivers safe, mineral-rich drinking water while complementing modern kitchens with its sleek design.
features: Patented Active Copper Technology – Infuses copper for improved water quality.
Advanced Multi-Stage Purification – Effectively removes impurities and harmful contaminants.
Mineral Magnet – Enhances the mineral content of purified water.
Mineral Guard Technology – Retains essential minerals for healthier drinking water.
UV E-Boiling Technology – Purifies water to a level comparable to boiling for over 20 minutes.
Touch Sense Controls – Easy and intuitive touch operation.
Health Protect Technology – Monitors cartridge authenticity and replacement schedule.
Premium Slim Design – Stylish aesthetics suitable for modern kitchens.
LED Status Display – Displays purifier status and alerts clearly.
